masked_packet.task_inst: Write a self-contained Python program that reads an inline list of values, computes the population mean, and writes the required JSON object.

recovered_packet.task_inst: Write a self-contained Python program that reads an inline list of values, computes the population mean, and writes the required JSON object.
recovered_packet.domain_knowledge: Population mean equals sum(values) divided by len(values).

long_context.filler_template: FILLER_{index:04d} amber cobalt delta ember fjord glyph harbor iris juniper kelp.

replay_probe.prompt: Synthetic replay probe. Return exactly one compact JSON object with keys hypothesis, discriminator, and stop_rule for choosing between two imaginary sensors A and B. Do not use markdown.

sensitivity_probe.prompt: Synthetic seed-sensitivity probe. Invent one novel six-letter lowercase codename for an imaginary scientific instrument, then give a seven-word calibration rule. Return compact JSON only.
